b=math w=output.setNumber j=input.getNumber z=b.sqrt o=b.cos r=b.sin function c(a,n,q)return{a or 0,n or 0,q or 0,l=function(_,d)return type(d)=="table" and _[1]*d[1]+_[2]*d[2]+_[3]*d[3]or c(_[1]*d,_[2]*d,_[3]*d)end,s=function(_,d)return c(_[1]+d[1],_[2]+d[2],_[3]+d[3])end,H=function(_,m)return m[1]:l(_[1]):s(m[2]:l(_[2])):s(m[3]:l(_[3]))end,t=function(_,m)return c(_:l(m[1]),_:l(m[2]),_:l(m[3]))end}end function B(a,n,q,F)local i,g,f,k,h,e=r(a),o(a),r(n),o(n),r(q),o(q)return F~=Q and{c(k*e,k*h,-f),c(i*f*e-g*h,i*f*h+g*e,i*k),c(g*f*e+i*h,g*f*h-i*e,g*k)}or{c(e*g+h*f*i,-h*k,h*f*g-e*i),c(h*g-e*f*i,e*k,-e*f*g-h*i),c(i*k,f,g*k)}end function M(u,v)return{u[1]:t(v),u[2]:t(v),u[3]:t(v)}end pi=b.pi p=pi*2 sin=r cos=o acos=b.acos asin=b.asin atan=b.atan tan=b.tan abs=b.abs sqrt=z I=b.log function J(a)return a<0 and-1 or 1 end function L(a,G,E)return b.min(b.max(a,G),E)end function len(a,n)return z(a^2+n^2)end function K(a)return a%p end function N(a)return(a-pi)%p-pi end O=0 function onTick()D=c(j(1),j(2),j(3))C=B(j(4),j(5),j(6))x=c(j(7),j(8),j(9))A=B(x[1]*p,x[2]*p,0,Q)[3]:l(x[3])P=A:H(C)y=A:s(D)w(1,y[1])w(2,y[2])w(3,y[3])end
